mostWorthwhile.text: Making the wick and fitting it to the lettuce was the most worthwhile part: it gave me a tangible low-power way to care for the plants.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final lamp preparation and mounting were predictable and offered little explanation or surprise.

surprise.text: I was curious that the two beds used different watering approaches, but the results did not explain why.

arbitrary.text: The circulator and wick both had clear general purposes, but choosing different methods for the two beds felt unexplained.

continue.text: I would continue for the larger story of the frozen discovery and the station, though this chapter's straightforward actions alone did not strongly draw me onward.
